gates.detail: The source file has 691 records. Pages list the 189 eligible records. Held and excluded records are left out. This is not signed off for a public build.
Parks and Wildlife Service alerts are read from the alerts page when Tasmania pages are built. Only the headline, the park names and the link are kept.
Lake St Clair Tourist Park is eligible and is a tourist park. The check fails while a caravan, holiday or tourist park is published. There is no keep list.
Pages link to the Tasmania Fire Service Total Fire Ban page and TasALERT. No fire rating is fetched.
Pages link to Tasmanian roadworks. The State Growth layer is not ingested.
No Tasmania segment is created. Signup stays off. Pages say the weekly email is coming soon.
Foundation tests are not a substitute for a fresh Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland and South Australia check at activation.
